name: Splendid Venice
positioning: Historic Starhotels Collezione hotel in the San Marco area of Venice, between St Mark's Square and the Rialto Bridge, with its own gondola and water-taxi dock and a rooftop altana
best_for: Travelers who want to explore Venice on foot, with St Mark's Square and the Rialto Bridge both within walking distance
Guests who want a suite with a private terrace looking toward Saint Mark's
Visitors curious about Venetian crafts such as Murano glass and Carnival masks

facts.text: The hotel has a central yet secluded location just steps from St Mark's Square and the Rialto Bridge.
The hotel is within walking distance of Saint Mark's Square in one direction and the Rialto Bridge in the other.
The hotel has a private dock for gondolas and water taxis.
The hotel's interiors blend rich colors, precious fabrics and design pieces.
The lobby is a succession of small Levantine parlors.
Rooms are decorated in silver, brown and lilac, with wallpapers and damask designs that evoke Venice's textile tradition.
Several rooms have balconies and views over St Mark's.
The Splendid Heritage Suites are a tribute to Venice's textile tradition, each with a bedroom and a separate sitting area.
Le Maschere restaurant, led by Venice-born Executive Chef Massimo Livan, serves Venetian-inspired dishes focused on fresh local fish.
The Lounge Bar has large picture windows looking onto the canal, where gondolas glide by.
Among the hotel's craft experiences, guests can make their own Venetian papier-mache mask at Ca' Macana.
The Family Connecting Room is designed for families travelling with children.

highlights.text: Splendid Venice traces its roots to the 16th century, when part of it formed the Black Hat Inn.
The Presidential Suite has a private double terrace with views of Saint Mark's, the Campanile and the city's rooftops.
The Altana is a traditional Venetian rooftop terrace on top of the hotel, serving cocktails and wine with views over the city.
The hotel's craft experiences include a visit to an authentic Murano glass factory at Berengo Studio.
Deluxe Canal View rooms have details recalling classic Venetian style and canal views.

considerations.text: The mixologist experience on the rooftop Altana is offered on summer evenings.
WhataHotel notes compact room sizes, typical of a historic Venetian building.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the central Venice location.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Splendid Venice, Starhotels Collezione
